info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Contribution Analysi Review-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to submit and manage reviews for contribution analysis reports. It allows users to provide feedback and insights on specific analyses, facilitating better decision-making and refinement of business strategies. Common consumers include analysts, business managers, and operational teams who rely on comprehensive reviews to enhance the accuracy of their contributions. Through this API, organizations can streamline the review process, ensuring timely and thorough evaluations while fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.

post.summary: Create a new review for the contribution analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review related to a specific contribution analysis identified by RES-100045. The review can provide insights and feedback that contribute to the overall assessment of the analysis.

requestBody.description: Provides the data necessary to create a new review for the specified contribution analysis resource. This includes detailed information that characterizes the review being submitted, ensuring proper integration with the system's existing analyses.
